paper_title: MICROSCOPE mission: first constraints on the violation of the weak equivalence principle by a light scalar dilaton
coupling_convention: dimensionless alpha (Yukawa strength relative to gravity) for q=B
notes: MICROSCOPE WEP test constrains a composition-dependent scalar fifth force. For a scalar coupling to baryon number B, |alpha|<1e-11 for m_phi<1e-12 eV (range >~1e5 m). This is a flat mass-independent bound; encoded as horizontal line over the valid mass range (m<1e-12 eV, extended down). Note the paper also reports |alpha|<1e-12 for q=B-L, and dilaton coupling constraints (D_m~, D_e, d_e). Chosen ScalarBaryon per baryon-number coupling result. Confidence lowered because paper covers multiple couplings (B, B-L, de -> ScalarPhoton) and the reported bounds are order-of-magnitude statements, not tabulated.
